models_evaluated: WHO Skin NTDs app (convolutional neural network)

links.outcome: FHW reliance on or deferral to AI diagnostic output
links.effect: Most FHWs used the app as an assistive tool, but a minority reported diagnostic deferral to the AI output, raising clinical autonomy concerns.
links.quote: While most FHWs used the app in line with its intended role as an assistive tool, a minority reported situations of diagnostic deferral to the AI output, highlighting potential considerations of clinical autonomy.

unlisted_practices: Embedding AI diagnostic tools within ethical and pedagogical frameworks to support capacity building
Offline functionality to address internet dependency of AI apps

screen.reason: The study qualitatively evaluates real-world implementation and clinician perspectives on the WHO Skin NTDs app across clinics in Kenya, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice with a comparator.
